title: Grade 2 French — Tue, May 26
description: La famille — Day 2 of 5: Mon/ma/mes — my family possessives
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'my father' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mon père' = My father. 'Mon' is used with masculine nouns like père.

questions.question: How do you say 'my mother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ma mère' = My mother. 'Ma' is used with feminine nouns like mère.

questions.question: How do you say 'my brothers' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mes frères' = My brothers. 'Mes' is used for ALL plural nouns (masculine or feminine).

questions.question: Fill in: '___ sœur est belle.' (My sister)
questions.explanation: 'Ma sœur est belle.' = My sister is beautiful. 'Ma' = my (feminine singular).

questions.question: Fill in: '___ grand-père a 75 ans.' (My grandfather)
questions.explanation: 'Mon grand-père a 75 ans.' = My grandfather is 75. Grand-père is masculine → mon.

questions.question: Fill in: '___ parents sont gentils.' (My parents)
questions.explanation: 'Mes parents sont gentils.' = My parents are kind. Parents is plural → mes.

questions.question: When do you use 'mon' instead of 'ma'?
options: With all nouns beginning with a vowel
questions.explanation: 'Mon' is used with masculine nouns (père, frère, oncle). Exception: also used before feminine nouns starting with a vowel (mon amie).

questions.question: Which is correct for 'my aunt'?
questions.explanation: 'Ma tante' = My aunt. Tante is feminine → ma.

questions.question: How do you say 'my sisters' (plural)?
questions.explanation: 'Mes sœurs' = My sisters. Plural always uses 'mes', regardless of gender.

questions.question: Complete: 'J'ai ___ frère et ___ sœur.' (one brother, one sister)
questions.explanation: 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' = I have a brother and a sister. Un (masculine), une (feminine).

questions.question: Which is correct: 'Ma oncle' or 'Mon oncle'?
questions.explanation: 'Mon oncle' = My uncle. Oncle is masculine → mon.

questions.question: How do you say 'my family' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ma famille' = My family. Famille is feminine → ma.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: '___ grand-mère fait de la soupe.' (My grandmother)
questions.explanation: 'Ma grand-mère fait de la soupe.' = My grandmother makes soup. Grand-mère is feminine → ma.

questions.question: When do you use 'mes'?
questions.explanation: 'Mes' = my (plural). Use it for BOTH masculine and feminine when there are two or more: mes frères, mes sœurs, mes parents.

questions.question: Complete: 'Dans ma famille, j'ai ___ père, ___ mère et ___ sœurs.' (my/my/my)
questions.explanation: 'J'ai mon père (masc), ma mère (fem), mes sœurs (plural).' Mon/ma/mes — each matches the noun's gender and number.
